summary: Makati 2nd District representative with 2 principal-authored bills: barangay fiscal administration and digital-likeness protection. Co-authored gig-worker, minimum wage and anti-dynasty bills.
caveat: Very small authored record; no dimension reaches two issues.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Only labor-protection evidence (co-authored gig-worker and minimum wage bills).
